name: org.evebrief.oracle/risk-check
title: EveBrief Risk Oracle (ERO)
description: EVM token/wallet risk: rug pulls, rug factories, copycats, contract. $0.004 per check via x402.

tools.name: check_address
tools.description: Paid per call via x402 ($0.005): RLUSD on XRPL, USDC on Base or USDC/USDT on Solana. Also Solana mint addresses (chain solana): mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions, fakes. Checks a token, deployer or wallet for rug pulls proven on-chain (with the buyers' loss), rug-factory networks, linked wallets and possible fakes of known tokens; with deep=true also live contract red flags and the contract's own name and symbol checked against known tokens (mint, pause, blacklist, mutable fees, upgradeable code; ~5 s slower, same price). Returns a risk verdict (none, low, high, critical) with reasons and evidence; findings separates on-chain facts with transactions from heuristic signals. Critical requires on-chain proof. 'none' means no record, not that an address is safe. Call without payment to get the payment terms, then repeat with _meta["x402/payment"].

address.description: EVM address: token, deployer, wallet or contract.

chain.description: Optional chain name or id, for example base.

check.description: Which check to buy: one single check (rug_pull, rug_factory, copycat, copycat_factory, contract; 0.004 each) or full (all checks and the overall level, 0.017). Without check: the classic full check at the old price, for a transition period.

deep.description: Also run the live, read-only contract check (owner privileges such as mint, pause, blacklist, mutable fees, upgradeable proxy). About 5 s slower, same price. Result in checks.contract: high only for paused trading or dangerous owner controls in an unlisted token, otherwise low at most.

tools.name: preview_address
tools.description: Free, no payment. Says only whether ERO has an on-chain proven record for the address (record true/false), on which chains, and whether it is a token or a wallet; known names a publicly listed token (symbol, sources) or known infrastructure. No risk level, no evidence, no amounts: use check_address for the full verdict. record=false does not mean safe.
